name: Smallest useful release scope
summary: A product owner or founder with more features than capacity gets one page: what is in the first release and what is deferred, all tied to one user outcome, with the reason for each cut. The owner decides the scope; no effort is estimated beyond what is supplied.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of product-management work, and its own method: an outcome path, six kinds of feature, ordered rules for in and deferred, dependency pull-in, and a capacity check that names what each removal costs without choosing.
